quotes: Great food for moderate prices.
just prices are slightly on a high side.

themes.label: Service quality and speed
themes.text: Many reviewers praise friendly, helpful staff and bartenders, but others report rude staff, slow ordering, long waits and a busy, hectic room.
quotes: All of the hosts were so helpful. And my waitress was just the best.
Pathetic service. Expect to wait at least 20min to order.

themes.label: Brisket, ribs and smoked meats
themes.text: Ribs, brisket, pork belly and wings are often called great and smoky, though some found the brisket and other meat dry, salty or bland.
quotes: Pork belly and ribs are amazing!
our group of six were pretty disappointed about the bland and dry meat

themes.label: Drinks and bar
themes.text: Reviewers like the cocktails, beer selection and bartenders, naming the donkey punch, white lightning lemonade and rum punch.
quotes: my favorite drink the white lightning lemonade is super yummy with fresh berries
Savory meats, awesome drink selection, and a great atmosphere.

themes.label: Sides and appetizers
themes.text: Mac and cheese, fried green tomatoes, deviled eggs, corn bread and other sides get praise, though some found sides small, bland or the mac too peppery.
quotes: The bbq baked beans are phenomenal as is the mac and cheese.
the sides are to small

themes.label: Prices and portions
themes.text: Several reviewers found prices reasonable and portions generous, while others called the food overpriced or the portions small.
quotes: Tons of food at reasonable prices. We had enough leftovers for another large meal at home the next day.
Portions small. Food alright.

themes.label: Crab legs
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly single out the crab legs as the signature dish, calling them delicious, seasoned well and the best they have had.
quotes: Best CRAB LEGS HANDS DOWN but great food PERIOD.
Crab legs are amazing and the crab leg soup. I love the seafood in general.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Most reviewers praise friendly, attentive staff, but some describe inattentive, unfriendly or uninformed waiters and uneven service.
quotes: The staff is polite and courteous, and the food is deli ious, and served in a timely matter.
The worst waitress ever. She didn't know what was on the menu she didn't know if they had anyting available

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Several reviewers find the diner expensive or overpriced, though a couple feel the quality or treatment justifies the cost.
quotes: ridiculous EXTREMELY HIGH prices. I had the WORST Burger I've ever had.
Getting a little pricey but they treat their employees and customers well so I don't mind paying.

themes.label: Drinks quality
themes.text: Drinks get uneven comments: some find them weak, oddly flavored or hit or miss, while others call them good and strong.
quotes: it seems no one except the bartender knows anything about the drinks.
The drinks at this place are good and strong.

themes.label: Waits and parking
themes.text: Reviewers mention long waits for a table, crowding on busy nights, and tight or insufficient parking.
quotes: Majority of the time long wait lines. Honestly can't recommend diner is worth waiting 30+ mins to seat.
The parking here is horrible. Tight spaces

themes.label: Food quality and variety
themes.text: Many reviewers praise delicious Spanish food and a wide choice of dishes, drinks and stalls, with tapas, cured meats and octopus singled out.
quotes: Great energy, food (quality and variety) and drink! A fun time
there are many delicious things to eat

themes.label: Paella disappointing
themes.text: Several reviewers found the paella dry, lacking flavor or marginal, though one praised a squid ink paella and another liked it.
quotes: skip the paella it's not great as it's dry, unsatisfying and really just not as good compared to the tapas available nearby
The paella was not good, it lacks flavor, more meat, the portions are small and expensive.

themes.label: Crowds, noise and seating
themes.text: Reviewers describe the market as crowded, noisy and cramped, with too little seating and long lines.
quotes: They could have benefited from having more seating, or at least high tops to stand around while you enjoy your food.
Very noisy. Limited seating. Overcrowded.

themes.label: Prices and portions
themes.text: Some call prices reasonable or good value, while others find food and drinks expensive with small portions; one found tapas portions huge.
quotes: Great value for the money considering it's in NYC.

themes.label: Atmosphere and Spanish feel
themes.text: Many enjoyed the lively, beautiful market setting and its Spanish feel, though a few said it did not feel like a real mercado.
quotes: this place is just thriving...burgeoning with life!!!
Good atmosphere. It reminded me of being in Barcelona.
